note: Tier-3 threat deck: 11 cards (3 Universal, 3 Military, Military + Economic, and one each led by Influence, Cyber, Economic, Grid). Late squeeze: tier 3 is dealt only by stage-III Militarist events, so rounds 10-11 (9-11 at difficulty 2+). Values are sane starting points, not tuned. 142: counters print the real amounts paid, scarce currencies first and credits last, never a currency the card's harm takes; every uncountered tier-3 threat also destroys 3 of each near player's nodes near it (adversary.threat_nodes), so no counter takes nodes; values at configs/agents/values.json (credits 1, chips 2, energy 4.5, insight 2.5, cube 3, ambassador 4, node 4). Each counter option is a list of items, all paid in full (pooled); the players pay one option. Value method on every card: harm = per-player harm x 1.5 (about 1.5 players near) + shared harm (compute, sway, pieces placed, sites), against the counter at the anchors; each value line gives the ratio against the cheapest option and against the credits option. A sacrificed tag prices 5 (3 tags 15); a sway or a Unity pull prices 4; a troop prices 9 (5 plus its strike). The unprinted 1 sway every uncountered threat makes is left out of every value.
